{"parentUuid":"a86c1f5c-54f6-49f9-a44a-aaaf5ed152c0","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"19cabd23-62a9-4395-b845-746dbb2308cd","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_013KbJfG52pHJRQtQnE7fKRc","type":"tool_result","content":"title:\tSpec: Kenyon CGE study abroad CMS — all 7 capabilities\nstate:\tOPEN\nauthor:\tadamleidercollege-code\nlabels:\tspec\ncomments:\t0\nassignees:\t\nprojects:\t\nmilestone:\t\nissue-type:\t\nparent:\t\nsub-issues:\t\nsub-issues-completed:\t\nblocked-by:\t\nblocking:\t\nnumber:\t1\n--\n## Problem Statement\n\nKenyon students researching study-abroad programs currently have to rely on outside sites that are poorly maintained and hard to search for specific answers (housing, meals, social life, academics). The Kenyon Center for Global Engagement (CGE) wants its own site where student Ambassadors who've actually attended a program write about it, but CGE must review every post before it goes public — nothing unapproved can reach a reader, and an Ambassador must never be able to touch anyone else's writing or the site's structure.\n\n## Solution\n\nA CMS with two roles — **Staff** (admin) and **Ambassador** (editor), see `CONTEXT.md` — where Ambassadors write and submit Posts, Staff review and publish them, and the public site is a static export organized as Home → Continent → Country → Program, with Posts grouped and filterable by Topic on their Program page. `CONTEXT.md` and `docs/adr/ADR-003`, `ADR-004` are the settled vocabulary and decisions this spec builds on; `notes/future-work.md` lists what's deliberately deferred.\n\n## User Stories\n\n**Login (capability 1)**\n1. As a Staff member, I want to log in with my email and password, so that I can access the admin console.\n2. As an Ambassador, I want to log in with my email and password, so that I can write and manage my own posts.\n3. As any user, I want a wrong password refused without the response revealing whether the account exists, so that no one can probe for valid emails.\n4. As a deactivated user, I want my login refused, so that I can't access the system after my account is deactivated.\n5. As any logged-in user, I want to log out, so that I can end my session on a shared computer.\n\n**Roles (capability 2)**\n6. As a Staff member, I want every Ambassador capability available to me too, so that I can write and submit my own Posts without a second account.\n7. As an Ambassador, I want to be blocked from any admin-only route, so that I can't reach user management or page authoring.\n8. As an anonymous visitor, I want to be redirected to login when I request an admin route, so that the admin console stays private.\n\n**Posts: authoring and the review gate (capability 3, ADR-004)**\n9. As an Ambassador, I want to create a new draft Post under a Program, so that I can start writing about my experience there.\n10. As an Ambassador, I want to edit my own draft Post's title, body, and Topic, so that I can revise it before submitting.\n11. As an Ambassador, I want to delete my own draft Post, after confirming \"are you sure?\", so that I don't lose it to a misclick but can still abandon it.\n12. As an Ambassador, I want to submit my draft for review, so that CGE can decide whether to publish it.\n13. As an Ambassador, I want to be blocked from editing or deleting my Post once it's pending or published, so that nothing changes mid-review or after it's live without CGE knowing.\n14. As an Ambassador, I want to be blocked from touching another Ambassador's Post in any way, so that I can't edit, delete, or resubmit someone else's writing.\n15. As a Staff member, I want to publish a pending Post, so that it goes live on the public site.\n16. As a Staff member, I want to bounce a pending Post back to draft, so that its author can revise it before I reconsider.\n17. As a Staff member, I want to publish my own draft Post directly, so that I don't have to route my own work through a review queue.\n18. As a Staff member, I want the option to submit my own Post to pending instead, so that another Staff member can review it first.\n19. As a Staff member, I want to edit or delete any Post regardless of status or author, so that I can fix a problem or remove content without waiting on anyone.\n20. As a Staff member, I want to unpublish a live Post back to draft, so that I can pull it down for a larger rewrite.\n\n**Pages and the content tree (capability 4)**\n21. As a Staff member, I want to create a Page nested under an existing Page (Home, a Continent, or a Country), so that I can build out the Continent → Country → Program tree.\n22. As a Staff member, I want to create a standalone Page directly under Home (e.g. \"About CGE\"), so that I can publish information that isn't travel content.\n23. As a Staff member, I want to flag a Page to show in the footer, so that standalone pages are reachable without cluttering the main navigation.\n24. As a Staff member, I want to edit or delete any Page, so that I can keep the site's structure current as programs change.\n25. As an Ambassador, I want to be blocked from creating, editing, or deleting any Page, so that the site's structure stays under CGE's control.\n\n**Topic (ADR-004 scope note, field notes)**\n26. As a visitor reading a Program page, I want its Posts grouped by Topic, so that I can jump straight to Housing or Academics instead of scrolling through everything.\n27. As a visitor reading a Program page, I want to filter to one Topic or see everything, so that I only see what I'm looking for.\n28. As an Ambassador, I want to tag my Post with a Topic when I write it, so that it lands in the right section of the Program page.\n\n**Public navigation (field notes, client brief)**\n29. As a visitor on any public page, I want a nav bar with Home and the Continents, so that I can jump to a different region from anywhere.\n30. As a visitor drilled into a Program page, I want a breadcrumb trail (Home → Continent → Country → Program), so that I can see where I am and step back up a level at a time.\n31. As a visitor, I want a footer linking to standalone pages like \"About CGE\" and \"Contact Us\", so that I can find that information from anywhere on the site.\n32. As a visitor on a phone, I want the nav bar to wrap or collapse, so that it never runs off the screen.\n\n**Admin console (capability 5)**\n33. As a Staff member, I want my admin home screen to be a live preview of the site, so that I land on what's actually published, the way WordPress's own admin works.\n34. As a Staff member, I want a Dashboard tab with counts (Posts by status, Pages by level, active accounts), so that I can see the state of the whole site at a glance.\n35. As a Staff member, I want a Pending queue tab listing every Post waiting on a decision, so that nothing sits unreviewed because no one thought to check.\n36. As a Staff member, I want a Metrics tab showing Posts per Program, so that I can see which programs have no Ambassador content yet.\n37. As an Ambassador, I want a \"My posts\" view listing my own drafts, pending, and published Posts, so that I can track what I've written without seeing anyone else's.\n\n**User management (capability 6)**\n38. As a Staff member, I want an Accounts tab to create users, assign a role, and activate/deactivate an account, so that I can manage who has access.\n39. As a Staff member, I want a deactivated Ambassador's draft Posts deleted automatically, so that the content list doesn't fill up with abandoned half-finished student work.\n40. As a Staff member, I want a deactivated Staff colleague's drafts left in place, viewable, editable, publishable, and deletable by any other Staff member just like any other content, so that CGE's own unfinished work isn't lost just because whoever started it left.\n41. As a Staff member, I want a deactivated user's pending and published content left exactly as it is, so that I can still publish what's in the queue and readers keep seeing valuable published content.\n42. As a visitor, I want a published Post to keep showing its original author's name even after that account is deactivated, so that the byline stays honest.\n\n**Public site and publish (capability 7)**\n43. As a Staff member, I want `cms publish` to write only published Posts and Pages into `site/`, so that nothing in draft or pending ever leaks to the public.\n44. As a Staff member, I want every link and asset in the exported HTML to be relative, so that the site works on its GitHub Pages subpath.\n45. As a visitor, I want a Post's Markdown rendered as sanitized HTML, so that nothing an Ambassador wrote can inject a script into the page I'm reading.\n46. As a Staff member, I want a slug frozen the instant something is published, so that a link a reader has already shared never breaks.\n\n## Implementation Decisions\n\n**Module split** (new, per this spec): `app/models.py` — plain SQLite access (no ORM, per ADR-002), `User`/`Page`/`Post` reads and writes. `app/services/` — pure rules with no FastAPI or SQLite dependency: slug generation, the status state machine, the deactivation cascade. `app/routes/` — thin HTTP handlers that call services for decisions and models for persistence. `templates/` — unchanged, `admin/` and `public/` subtrees as already established.\n\n**Data model** (logical, fields not file-bound):\n- `User`: id, email, password_hash (argon2), role (`admin`/`editor`), display_name, active (bool), timestamps.\n- `Page`: id, parent_id (nullable only for Home), title, slug, body (Markdown), status (`draft`/`published` — **no `pending`**: only Staff author Pages, and Staff can self-publish, so there's never a reviewer to wait on), `show_in_footer` (bool), author_id, timestamps, published_at.\n- `Post`: id, program_id (must reference a Program-level Page), title, slug, body (Markdown), topic (`general`/`housing`/`meals`/`social-life`/`academics`/`other`), status (`draft`/`pending`/`published`), author_id, timestamps, published_at.\n\n**Status state machine** (services layer; a decision this precise is clearer as a table than prose):\n\n| From | Action | Who | To |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| draft | submit | the Post's own author (any role) | pending |\n| pending | publish | any admin | published |\n| pending | bounce | any admin | draft |\n| draft | self-publish | admin, **own Post only** | published |\n| published | unpublish | any admin | draft |\n\nNo other transition exists. In particular, an admin cannot move *someone else's* draft straight to published — it must be submitted to pending first, same as anyone's. This keeps \"an Ambassador's post is never published without someone deciding to put it through pending\" true even when the decider is an admin, not just an Ambassador.\n\n**Content edit/delete permission** (orthogonal to status, from `CONTEXT.md`'s Staff/Ambassador entries): admin — any Post or Page, any status, always. Editor — only their own Post, only while draft. Never any Page.\n\n**Slug generation**: derived from title (lowercase, non-alphanumeric runs collapsed to hyphens). Regenerates on every title change while status is draft; frozen the moment status leaves draft, even if an admin edits the title afterward. On a collision with a sibling under the same parent, append `-2`, `-3`, … — not grilled explicitly; flagged below.\n\n**Deactivation cascade** (services layer): the cascade is role-specific, not uniform. Deactivating an **Ambassador** deletes their draft Posts — nothing worth keeping from a student who's left. Deactivating a **Staff member** deletes nothing: their drafts (Posts or Pages) stay exactly as they are, and since admin permission is \"any Post or Page, any status, always\" (see Content edit/delete permission above), any other Staff member can already view, edit, publish, or delete them like any other content — Staff drafts are usually CGE's own ongoing work, not a departing student's. Pending and published content is left untouched regardless of which role is deactivated, byline intact.\n\n**Public URL / nav contract**: a Page's public path is the slug chain of its ancestors from Home (Home = site root); a Post's path nests under its Program's path. A footer-flagged standalone Page still gets a path under Home, just excluded from Home's own child listing (`CONTEXT.md`, Page).\n\n**Admin console layout**: Staff's landing screen is a live preview of the site inside the console; sidebar tabs are Dashboard, Pending queue, Accounts, Page hierarchy, Metrics. Ambassador's sidebar is just \"My posts\". No reviewer assignment and no notifications on the pending queue — any admin can act on any pending Post.\n\n## Testing Decisions\n\nA good test asserts externally observable behavior — status code, redirect target, response HTML, a written file's contents, or a service function's return value/raised error — never an internal implementation detail.\n\n- **HTTP seam** (`TestClient`, prior art: `tests/test_t00.py`, `conftest.py`'s `client_as(role)`): login success/failure/deactivated, every admin-only route rejected for an editor and for an anonymous request, Post/Page CRUD and every status-transition route end-to-end, CSRF rejection on a POST with the token stripped, the Dashboard/Pending-queue/Accounts/Metrics/My-posts screens, nav bar/breadcrumb/footer HTML on public pages.\n- **`render_site()` seam** (prior art: `test_publish_writes_a_site`, `test_published_html_uses_relative_paths`): a draft or pending Post/Page present but absent from the output, every href/src relative, sanitized Markdown in the exported HTML, a frozen slug surviving a post-publish title edit, nav/breadcrumb/footer present in the static files.\n- **Services seam** (new, no HTTP or DB — plain pytest functions): every cell of the status state-machine table including the disallowed combinations (e.g. editor attempting publish, admin attempting draft→published on someone else's Post), slug generation and its collision suffixing, the deactivation cascade's decision of which Posts/Pages to delete vs. keep.\n\n## Out of Scope\n\nPer ADR-003: private messaging, a visitor/commenter account role, an IT/developer role, view/comment-based search filters, in-CMS suggested-edit tooling. Per `notes/future-work.md`: trash/restore with a 30-day auto-delete (plain delete only, with a confirmation prompt), scheduled/visibility-gated publish. Per the grill (A6): sitewide/scoped search is a stretch ticket after the 7 capabilities, client-side against a JSON index built at publish time — not part of this spec's core tickets.\n\n## Further Notes\n\nThree points in this spec were synthesized (not explicitly grilled) because they follow directly from decisions already settled, and have been confirmed:\n\n1. **Pages have no `pending` status** — only `draft`/`published`, since only Staff author Pages and Staff can self-publish (ADR-004 only ever discusses Posts).\n2. **Slug collisions** get a numeric suffix (`-2`, `-3`, …), scoped to siblings sharing a parent — never explicitly asked.\n3. **An admin can't draft→published someone else's Post** — only their own; everyone else's still needs pending. ADR-004's \"into or out of published\" language is satisfied by the unpublish transition (published→draft), not by a second direct-publish shortcut.\n\nThe deactivation cascade (above) was corrected after an initial draft wrongly proposed deleting a deactivated Staff member's drafts too — it's Ambassador-only, confirmed.\n\n`scripts/seed_demo.py` will need Asia/Africa/Europe as Continents, a couple Countries under each, one or two Programs per Country, and generated placeholder copy at every level (A1) — a tickets-stage task, noted here so it isn't lost.","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"d2beec7a-59de-4810-b2c7-0334b2da06bb","timestamp":"2026-10-05T19:47:26.237Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"title:\tSpec: Kenyon CGE study abroad CMS — all 7 capabilities\nstate:\tOPEN\nauthor:\tadamleidercollege-code\nlabels:\tspec\ncomments:\t0\nassignees:\t\nprojects:\t\nmilestone:\t\nissue-type:\t\nparent:\t\nsub-issues:\t\nsub-issues-completed:\t\nblocked-by:\t\nblocking:\t\nnumber:\t1\n--\n## Problem Statement\n\nKenyon students researching study-abroad programs currently have to rely on outside sites that are poorly maintained and hard to search for specific answers (housing, meals, social life, academics). As a Staff member, I want a slug frozen the instant something is published, so that a link a reader has already shared never breaks.\n\n## Implementation Decisions\n\n**Module split** (new, per this spec): `app/models.py` — plain SQLite access (no ORM, per ADR-002), `User`/`Page`/`Post` reads and writes. `app/services/` — pure rules with no FastAPI or SQLite dependency: slug generation, the status state machine, the deactivation cascade. `app/routes/` — thin HTTP handlers that call services for decisions and models for persistence. `templates/` — unchanged, `admin/` and `public/` subtrees as already established.\n\n**Data model** (logical, fields not file-bound):\n- `User`: id, email, password_hash (argon2), role (`admin`/`editor`), display_name, active (bool), timestamps.\n- `Page`: id, parent_id (nullable only for Home), title, slug, body (Markdown), status (`draft`/`published` — **no `pending`**: only Staff author Pages, and Staff can self-publish, so there's never a reviewer to wait on), `show_in_footer` (bool), author_id, timestamps, published_at.\n- `Post`: id, program_id (must reference a Program-level Page), title, slug, body (Markdown), topic (`general`/`housing`/`meals`/`social-life`/`academics`/`other`), status (`draft`/`pending`/`published`), author_id, timestamps, published_at.\n\n**Status state machine** (services layer; a decision this precise is clearer as a table than prose):\n\n| From | Action | Who | To |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| draft | submit | the Post's own author (any role) | pending |\n| pending | publish | any admin | published |\n| pending | bounce | any admin | draft |\n| draft | self-publish | admin, **own Post only** | published |\n| published | unpublish | any admin | draft |\n\nNo other transition exists. In particular, an admin cannot move *someone else's* draft straight to published — it must be submitted to pending first, same as anyone's. This keeps \"an Ambassador's post is never published without someone deciding to put it through pending\" true even when the decider is an admin, not just an Ambassador.\n\n**Content edit/delete permission** (orthogonal to status, from `CONTEXT.md`'s Staff/Ambassador entries): admin — any Post or Page, any status, always. Editor — only their own Post, only while draft. Never any Page.\n\n**Slug generation**: derived from title (lowercase, non-alphanumeric runs collapsed to hyphens). Regenerates on every title change while status is draft; frozen the moment status leaves draft, even if an admin edits the title afterward. On a collision with a sibling under the same parent, append `-2`, `-3`, … — not grilled explicitly; flagged below.\n\n**Deactivation cascade** (services layer): the cascade is role-specific, not uniform. Deactivating an **Ambassador** deletes their draft Posts — nothing worth keeping from a student who's left. Deactivating a **Staff member** deletes nothing: their drafts (Posts or Pages) stay exactly as they are, and since admin permission is \"any Post or Page, any status, always\" (see Content edit/delete permission above), any other Staff member can already view, edit, publish, or delete them like any other content — Staff drafts are usually CGE's own ongoing work, not a departing student's. Pending and published content is left untouched regardless of which role is deactivated, byline intact.\n\n**Public URL / nav contract**: a Page's public path is the slug chain of its ancestors from Home (Home = site root); a Post's path nests under its Program's path. A footer-flagged standalone Page still gets a path under Home, just excluded from Home's own child listing (`CONTEXT.md`, Page).\n\n**Admin console layout**: Staff's landing screen is a live preview of the site inside the console; sidebar tabs are Dashboard, Pending queue, Accounts, Page hierarchy, Metrics. Ambassador's sidebar is just \"My posts\". No reviewer assignment and no notifications on the pending queue — any admin can act on any pending Post.\n\n## Testing Decisions\n\nA good test asserts externally observable behavior — status code, redirect target, response HTML, a written file's contents, or a service function's return value/raised error — never an internal implementation detail.\n\n- **HTTP seam** (`TestClient`, prior art: `tests/test_t00.py`, `conftest.py`'s `client_as(role)`): login success/failure/deactivated, every admin-only route rejected for an editor and for an anonymous request, Post/Page CRUD and every status-transition route end-to-end, CSRF rejection on a POST with the token stripped, the Dashboard/Pending-queue/Accounts/Metrics/My-posts screens, nav bar/breadcrumb/footer HTML on public pages.\n- **`render_site()` seam** (prior art: `test_publish_writes_a_site`, `test_published_html_uses_relative_paths`): a draft or pending Post/Page present but absent from the output, every href/src relative, sanitized Markdown in the exported HTML, a frozen slug surviving a post-publish title edit, nav/breadcrumb/footer present in the static files.\n- **Services seam** (new, no HTTP or DB — plain pytest functions): every cell of the status state-machine table including the disallowed combinations (e.g. editor attempting publish, admin attempting draft→published on someone else's Post), slug generation and its collision suffixing, the deactivation cascade's decision of which Posts/Pages to delete vs. keep.\n\n## Out of Scope\n\nPer ADR-003: private messaging, a visitor/commenter account role, an IT/developer role, view/comment-based search filters, in-CMS suggested-edit tooling. Per `notes/future-work.md`: trash/restore with a 30-day auto-delete (plain delete only, with a confirmation prompt), scheduled/visibility-gated publish. Per the grill (A6): sitewide/scoped search is a stretch ticket after the 7 capabilities, client-side against a JSON index built at publish time — not part of this spec's core tickets.\n\n## Further Notes\n\nThree points in this spec were synthesized (not explicitly grilled) because they follow directly from decisions already settled, and have been confirmed:\n\n1. **Pages have no `pending` status** — only `draft`/`published`, since only Staff author Pages and Staff can self-publish (ADR-004 only ever discusses Posts).\n2. **Slug collisions** get a numeric suffix (`-2`, `-3`, …), scoped to siblings sharing a parent — never explicitly asked.\n3. **An admin can't draft→published someone else's Post** — only their own; everyone else's still needs pending. ADR-004's \"into or out of published\" language is satisfied by the unpublish transition (published→draft), not by a second direct-publish shortcut.\n\nThe deactivation cascade (above) was corrected after an initial draft wrongly proposed deleting a deactivated Staff member's drafts too — it's Ambassador-only, confirmed.\n\n`scripts/seed_demo.py` will need Asia/Africa/Europe as Continents, a couple Countries under each, one or two Programs per Country, and generated placeholder copy at every level (A1) — a tickets-stage task, noted here so it isn't lost.","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a86c1f5c-54f6-49f9-a44a-aaaf5ed152c0","session_id":"386af32f-d2fc-4121-a09e-26f9c2df1842","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"158f09c3-0876-4c27-9efa-2133adbbe128","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

`csrf_token` for the\ndouble-submit CSRF check on every state-changing form.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.services import csrf, passwords\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nGENERIC_LOGIN_ERROR = \"Incorrect email or password.\"\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `require_user` for an anonymous request; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `require_admin` for a non-admin request; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass CsrfInvalid(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `verify_csrf` for a missing or wrong token; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef ensure_csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Make sure the session has a CSRF token, and return it for the form.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not token:\n        token = csrf.generate_token()\n        request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = token\n    return token\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    form = await request.form()\n    submitted = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    session_token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not csrf.tokens_match(session_token, submitted):\n        raise CsrfInvalid()\n\n\ndef get_current_user(request: Request) -> models.User | None:\n    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n    if user_id is None:\n        return None\n    user = models.get_user_by_id(user_id)\n    if user is None or not user.active:\n        return None\n    return user\n\n\ndef require_user(request: Request) -> models.User:\n    user = get_current_user(request)\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired()\n    return user\n\n\ndef require_admin(user: models.User = Depends(require_user)) -> models.User:\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        raise AdminRequired()\n    return user\n\n\n@router.get(\"/login\")\ndef login_form(request: Request):\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/login.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Log in\", \"csrf_token\": token, \"error\": None},\n    )\n\n\n@router.post(\"/login\")\nasync def login_submit(\n    request: Request,\n    email: str = Form(...),\n    password: str = Form(...),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    user = models.get_user_by_email(email)\n    if user is None or not user.active or not passwords.verify_password(\n        user.password_hash, password\n    ):\n        if user is None or not user.active:\n            passwords.waste_time_like_a_verify(password)\n        token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/login.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"Log in\", \"csrf_token\": token, \"error\": GENERIC_LOGIN_ERROR},\n            status_code=401,\n        )\n\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"user_id\"] = user.id\n    request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf.generate_token()\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/logout\")\nasync def logout(request: Request, _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf)):\n    request.session.clear()\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/_stub\")\ndef admin_only_stub(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/stub.html\", {\"title\": \"Admin-only stub\", \"user\": That is the whole skeleton — it exists so you can prove the stack\nruns before you build anything on it.\n\nAdd your routes in their own modules (app/routes/posts.py and so on) and include\nthem here. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, models, settings\nfrom app.routes import auth, pages, public\nfrom app.routes.auth import (\n    AdminRequired,\n    CsrfInvalid,\n    LoginRequired,\n    ensure_csrf_token,\n    get_current_user,\n)\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    db.init_db()\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                        session_cookie=\"cms_session\")\n\n    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    def _login_required(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(AdminRequired)\n    def _admin_required(request: Request, exc: AdminRequired):\n        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden\", status_code=403)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(CsrfInvalid)\n    def _csrf_invalid(request: Request, exc: CsrfInvalid):\n        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden: missing or invalid CSRF token\", status_code=403)\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(pages.router)\n\n    @app.get(\"/admin\")\n    def admin_home(request: Request, user: models.User | None = Depends(get_current_user)):\n        csrf_token = ensure_csrf_token(request) if user else None\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"user\": user, \"csrf_token\": csrf_token},\n        )\n\n    # Catch-all last: the live public site, read straight from the database —\n    # the admin console's \"preview\" of what `cms publish` will later export.\n    app.include_router(public.router)\n\n    # python3\n\"\"\"Create demo data so a grader (and you) can use the CMS immediately.\n\n    uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py\n\nT00 has nothing to seed. As you build content types, extend this so it creates:\n  - one admin and one editor (passwords read from .env, never hard-coded)\n  - a few posts and pages, at least one draft and one published\n\nThe rubric expects this to run clean on a fresh clone with .env.example values\n(item E4), because the database itself is never committed.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\n\nsys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))\n\nfrom app import db, models  # noqa: E402\n\n# Continent -> Country -> [Program, ...], per T02's seed requirement.\nCONTINENTS = {\n    \"Asia\": {\n        \"Japan\": [\"Kyoto Exchange\"],\n        \"South Korea\": [\"Seoul Studies\"],\n    },\n    \"Africa\": {\n        \"Kenya\": [\"Nairobi Fieldwork\"],\n        \"South Africa\": [\"Cape Town Semester\"],\n    },\n    \"Europe\": {\n        \"Spain\": [\"Madrid Language Immersion\"],\n        \"France\": [\"Paris Arts & Culture\"],\n    },\n}\nSTANDALONE_PAGES = [\"About CGE\", \"Contact Us\"]\n\n\ndef _placeholder_body(title: str) -> str:\n    return (\n        f\"Placeholder copy for **{title}**. Replace this with real content \"\n        \"once CGE has something to say here.\"\n    )\n\n\ndef _seed_pages(admin_id: int) -> None:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    if models.list_children(home.id):\n        print(\"Pages already seeded, leaving the tree as-is.\")\n        return\n\n    def _add(parent_id: int, title: str, show_in_footer: bool = False) -> models.Page:\n        page = models.create_page(\n            parent_id=parent_id, title=title, body=_placeholder_body(title),\n            show_in_footer=show_in_footer, author_id=admin_id,\n        )\n        return models.publish_page(page.id)\n\n    for continent_title, countries in CONTINENTS.items():\n        continent = _add(home.id, continent_title)\n        for country_title, programs in countries.items():\n            country = _add(continent.id, country_title)\n            for program_title in programs:\n                _add(country.id, program_title)\n\n    for standalone_title in STANDALONE_PAGES:\n        _add(home.id, standalone_title, show_in_footer=True)\n\n    print(\"Seeded the Continent -> Country -> Program tree and standalone pages.\")\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    admin_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\")\n    editor_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\")\n    deactivated_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_DEACTIVATED_PASSWORD\", \"change-me-deactivated\")\n    if not admin_pw or not editor_pw:\n        print(\"Set CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD in .env \"\n              \"(copy .env.example).\")\n        return 1\n\n    db.init_db()\n    for email, pw, role, name, active in [\n        (\"admin@example.test\", admin_pw, \"admin\", \"Staff Demo\", True),\n        (\"editor@example.test\", editor_pw, \"editor\", \"Ambassador Demo\", True),\n        (\"deactivated@example.test\", deactivated_pw, \"editor\", \"Deactivated Demo\", False),\n    ]:\n        if models.get_user_by_email(email) is None:\n            models.create_user(email=email, password=pw, role=role,\n                                display_name=name, active=active)\n    print(\"Seeded admin, editor, and deactivated demo users.\")\n\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    _seed_pages(admin.id)\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n","numLines":100,"startLine":1,"totalLines":100}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"9d5eaced-0d0c-4e32-b381-aa6bbe6cbc33","session_id":"386af32f-d2fc-4121-a09e-26f9c2df1842","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"158f09c3-0876-4c27-9efa-2133adbbe128","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

Submitting for review,\npublishing, bouncing, and unpublishing are T04 (#5), not here.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, require_user, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import markdown\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\")\n\n\ndef _get_program_or_404(program_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    program = models.get_page_by_id(program_id)\n    if program is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such program page\")\n    return program\n\n\ndef _get_post_or_404(post_id: int) -> models.Post:\n    post = models.get_post_by_id(post_id)\n    if post is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such post\")\n    return post\n\n\ndef _authorize_post_write(user: models.User, post: models.Post) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Admin: any Post, any status. Editor: only their own, only while draft.\"\"\"\n    if user.role == \"admin\":\n        return\n    if post.author_id != user.id or post.status != \"draft\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Forbidden\")\n\n\ndef _render_form(\n    request: Request,\n    post: models.Post | None,\n    program: models.Page,\n    error: str | None = None,\n    title: str = \"\",\n    body: str = \"\",\n    topic: str = \"general\",\n):\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_form.html\",\n        {\n            \"title\": \"Edit post\" if post else \"New post\",\n            \"post\": post,\n            \"program\": program,\n            \"csrf_token\": token,\n            \"error\": error,\n            \"form_title\": title,\n            \"form_body\": body,\n            \"form_topic\": topic,\n            \"preview_html\": markdown.render(body),\n            \"topics\": models.TOPIC_CHOICES,\n        },\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_posts(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    posts = models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        posts = [p for p in posts if p.author_id == user.id]\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_list.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Posts\", \"program\": program, \"posts\": posts, \"csrf_token\": return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/new\")\nasync def create_post(\n    request: Request,\n    program_id: int = Form(...),\n    title: str = Form(\"\"),\n topic=topic)\n    try:\n        models.create_post(\n            program_id=program_id, title=title, body=body, topic=topic, author_id=user.id,\n        )\n    except ValueError as exc:\n (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"3f5cc63b-a210-4bfa-97bc-b106612e08a3","timestamp":"2026-10-05T19:50:59.987Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/main.py","oldString":"from app.routes import auth, pages, public","newString":"from app.routes import auth, pages, posts, public","originalFile":"\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nT00 (already done): the admin console answers at /admin and the public site\nanswers at /. That is the whole skeleton — it exists so you can prove the stack\nruns before you build anything on it.\n\nAdd your routes in their own modules (app/routes/posts.py and so on) and include\nthem here. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, models, settings\nfrom app.routes import auth, pages, public\nfrom app.routes.auth import (\n    AdminRequired,\n    CsrfInvalid,\n    LoginRequired,\n    ensure_csrf_token,\n    get_current_user,\n)\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    db.init_db()\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                        session_cookie=\"cms_session\")\n\n    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    def _login_required(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(AdminRequired)\n    def _admin_required(request: Request, exc: AdminRequired):\n        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden\", status_code=403)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(CsrfInvalid)\n    def _csrf_invalid(request: Request, exc: CsrfInvalid):\n        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden: missing or invalid CSRF token\", status_code=403)\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(pages.router)\n\n    @app.get(\"/admin\")\n    def admin_home(request: Request, user: models.User | None = Depends(get_current_user)):\n        csrf_token = ensure_csrf_token(request) if user else None\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"user\": user, \"csrf_token\": csrf_token},\n        )\n\n    # Catch-all last: the live public site, read straight from the database —\n    # the admin console's \"preview\" of what `cms publish` will later export.\n    app.include_router(public.router)\n\n    # )\n        return models.publish_page(page.id)\n\n    for continent_title, countries in CONTINENTS.items():\n        continent = _add(home.id, continent_title)\n        for country_title, programs in Replace this with real content \"\n        \"once CGE has something to say here.\"\n    )\n\n\ndef _seed_pages(admin_id: int) -> list[models.Page]:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    if models.list_children(home.id):\n        print(\"Pages already seeded, leaving the tree as-is.\")\n        return [\n            program\n            for continent in models.list_children(home.id)\n            for country in models.list_children(continent.id)\n            for program in models.list_children(country.id)\n        ]\n\n    def _add(parent_id: int, title: str, show_in_footer: bool = False) -> models.Page:\n        page = models.create_page(\n            parent_id=parent_id, title=title, body=_placeholder_body(title),\n            show_in_footer=show_in_footer, author_id=admin_id,\n        )\n        return models.publish_page(page.id)\n\n    programs: list[models.Page] = []\n    for continent_title, countries in CONTINENTS.items():\n        continent = _add(home.id, continent_title)\n        for country_title, program_titles in countries.items():\n            country = _add(continent.id, country_title)\n            for program_title in program_titles:\n                programs.append(_add(country.id, program_title))\n\n    for standalone_title in STANDALONE_PAGES:\n        _add(home.id, standalone_title, show_in_footer=True)\n\n    print(\"Seeded the Continent -> Country -> Program tree and standalone pages.\")\n    return programs\n\n\ndef _seed_posts(programs: list[models.Page], editor_id: int) -> None:\n    if not programs or any(models.list_posts_by_program(p.id) for p in programs):\n        print(\"Posts already seeded (or no programs to seed under), leaving as-is.\")\n        return\n\n    for i, program in enumerate(programs):\n        topic = POST_TOPICS[i % len(POST_TOPICS)]\n        title = f\"My first week at {program.title}\"\n        models.create_post(\n            program_id=program.id, title=title, body=_placeholder_body(title),\n            topic=topic, author_id=editor_id,\n        )\n    print(f\"Seeded {len(programs)} draft posts across Topics under the seeded Programs.\")\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    admin_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\")\n    editor_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\")\n    deactivated_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_DEACTIVATED_PASSWORD\", \"change-me-deactivated\")\n    if not admin_pw or not editor_pw:\n        print(\"Set CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD in .env \"\n              \"(copy .env.example).\")\n        return 1\n\n    db.init_db()\n    for email, pw, role, name, active in [\n        (\"admin@example.test\", admin_pw, \"admin\", \"Staff Demo\", True),\n        (\"editor@example.test\", editor_pw, \"editor\", \"Ambassador Demo\", True),\n        (\"deactivated@example.test\", deactivated_pw, \"editor\", \"Deactivated Demo\", False),\n    ]:\n        if models.get_user_by_email(email) is None:\n            models.create_user(email=email, password=pw, role=role,\n                                display_name=name, active=active)\n    print(\"Seeded admin, editor, and deactivated demo users.\")\n\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    _seed_pages(admin.id)\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n program_id, title, body=\"Hello **world**\", topic=\"housing\"):\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program_id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    return c.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"program_id\": str(program_id), \"title\": title, \"body\": body,\n              \"topic\": topic, \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n\n\ndef test_editor_creates_edits_deletes_own_draft_post(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n  assert post.title == \"My First Week\"\n    assert post.slug == \"my-first-week\"\n    assert post.topic == \"housing\"\n    assert post.status == \"draft\"\n    editor = parent_author_id)\n\n\ndef _create_post(c, program_id, title, body=\"Hello **world**\", topic=\"housing\"):\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program_id}\")\n    token = post = models.list_posts_by_program(program.id)[0]\n    assert post.title == \"My First Week\"\n    assert post.slug == \"my-first-week\"\n    assert post.topic == \"housing\"\n    assert post.status edit_page.status_code == 200\n    token = _csrf_token_from(edit_page.text)\n    c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n           data={\"title\": \"Renamed Post\", \"body\": \"x\", \"topic\": \"are you sure\" in confirm.text.lower()\n    token = _csrf_token_from(confirm.text)\n    response = c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/delete\",\n                       data={\"csrf_token\": token}, assert \"<script>\" not in response.text\n    assert \"onerror=\" not in response.text\n    # Nothing was saved by the preview action.\n    assert models.list_posts_by_program(program.id) == \"topic\": \"housing\",\n                 \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token})\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).slug == \"renamed-title\"\n\n    # No submit/publish route exists yet home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    country = models.create_page(continent.id, \"Japan\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    return models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n\n\ndef _create_post(c, program_id, title, body=\"Hello **world**\", topic=\"housing\"):\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program_id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    return c.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"program_id\": str(program_id), \"title\": title, \"body\": body,\n              \"topic\": topic, \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n\n\ndef test_editor_creates_edits_deletes_own_draft_post(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    response = _create_post(c, program.id, \"My First Week\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n\n    post = models.list_posts_by_program(program.id)[0]\n    assert post.title == \"My First Week\"\n    assert post.slug == \"my-first-week\"\n    assert post.topic == \"housing\"\n    assert post.status == \"draft\"\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    assert post.author_id == editor.id\n\n    edit_page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\")\n    assert edit_page.status_code == 200\n    token = _csrf_token_from(edit_page.text)\n    c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n           data={\"title\": \"Renamed Post\", \"body\": \"x\", \"topic\": \"meals\",\n                 \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n           follow_redirects=False)\n    renamed = models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n    assert renamed.title == \"Renamed Post\"\n    assert renamed.slug == \"renamed-post\"\n    assert renamed.topic == \"meals\"\n\n    confirm = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/delete\")\n    assert confirm.status_code == 200\n    assert \"are you sure\" in confirm.text.lower()\n    token = _csrf_token_from(confirm.text)\n    response = c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/delete\",\n                       data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id) is None\n\n\ndef test_preview_shows_sanitized_html_without_saving(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program.id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    malicious = 'Hi <script>alert(1)</script> <img src=x onerror=\"alert(2)\">'\n    response = c.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"program_id\": str(program.id), \"title\": \"Draft\", response.text\n    assert \"onerror=\" not in response.text\n    # Nothing was saved by the preview action.\n    assert models.list_posts_by_program(program.id) == []\n\n\ndef test_slug_regenerates_while_draft_then_freezes_once_not_draft(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    _create_post(c, program.id, \"First Title\")\n    post = models.list_posts_by_program(program.id)[0]\n    assert post.slug == \"first-title\"\n\n    edit_page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(edit_page.text)\n    c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n           data={\"title\": \"Renamed Title\", \"body\": \"x\", \"topic\": \"housing\",\n                 \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token})\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).slug == \"renamed-title\"\n\n    # No submit/publish route exists yet (T04); exercise the model's freeze\n    # rule directly, same seam the spec calls out for the state machine.\n    from app import db\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE posts SET status = 'pending' WHERE id = ?\", (post.id,))\n    conn.commit()\n    conn.close()\n\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=\"Title After Pending\", body=\"x\", topic=\"housing\")\n    after = models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n    assert after.title == \"Title After Pending\"\n    assert after.slug == \"renamed-title\"  # frozen\n\n\ndef test_ambassador_blocked_from_another_users_post(client_as):\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    owner = client_as(\"editor\")\n {"parentUuid":"2103241c-a2b7-45cf-a8db-cd706c5ce40a","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"deferred_tools_record","entries":[{"name":"SendMessage","description":"# SendMessage\n\nSend a message to another agent.\n\n```json\n{\"to\": \"researcher\", \"summary\": \"assign task 1\", \"message\": \"start on task #1\"}\n```\n\n| `to` | |\n|---|---|\n| `\"researcher\"` | Teammate by name |\n| `\"main\"` | The main conversation (background subagents only) |\n| `\"worker\"` | Any agent from `ListAgents` — subagent, another local Claude session |\n| `\"worker [3fa9c1]\"` | Same, plus its `[ref]` — only when a listing or an error shows one |\n\nYour plain text output is NOT visible to other agents — to communicate, you MUST call this tool. Messages from teammates are delivered automatically; you don't check an inbox. Refer to agents by name — names keep working after an agent completes (a send resumes it from its transcript). Use the raw `agentId` (format `a...-...`) from its spawn result only when the agent has no name, or when a newer agent took the name (latest wins). When relaying, don't quote the original — it's already rendered to the user.\n\n## Cross-session\n\nUse `ListAgents` to discover targets. Every row leads with the agent's `name [ref]` — the name IS the address; there is no separate address syntax.\n\n```json\n{\"to\": \"worker\", \"message\": \"check if tests pass over there\"}\n{\"to\": \"worker [3fa9c1]\", \"message\": \"you, specifically\"}\n```\n\nSend the bare name — a name that exactly matches one live agent or session (on this machine, on another machine, or in the cloud) delivers directly. Append the ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — `ListAgents` shows two rows with it, or an error asks you to disambiguate (you typed only a prefix, or a session list could not be checked). A ref you did not just read from a listing or an error will not resolve, and if the same name also names an in-process agent, the bare name always wins — use the in-process one.\n\nA listed peer is alive and will receive your message; messages enqueue and drain at the receiver's next tool round (its `ListAgents` row says whether it is busy or idle right now). A successful send means the message reached that session, not that its Claude read it: a session running in a different permission mode than yours holds cross-session messages for its user's approval (and may let them expire), and a session can refuse them outright — for a session on this machine a `[Cross-session delivery notice]` tells you when that happens (the tool result says when this session has no inbox for one to reach); for a Remote Control, cloud or Claude Desktop session nothing reports back, so never treat silence as agreement. Your message arrives wrapped as `<cross-session-message from=\"...\">`. **To reply to an incoming message, copy its `from` attribute as your `to`.** Cross-session messages travel between SESSIONS: if you are a subagent, your send goes out under your parent session's address, and any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to you.\n\nTo hear when a session ON THIS MACHINE finishes what it is doing, pass `notify_when_idle: true` (from the main conversation only) — one-shot and opt-in: exactly one `[Cross-session idle notice]` arrives when it next goes idle (or exits) — shown to you, or only to your user when this session holds peer messages for approval (the tool result says which); if it never signals within the subscription's lifetime (it may still be busy, may refuse inbound requests, or may have ended abruptly) the notice says the subscription expired instead. Omit `message` for a pure subscription that costs that session nothing; include one to deliver it now AND subscribe. Never poll `ListAgents` in a loop or send \"are you done?\" messages instead.\n\nPermission boundaries are per-session: NEVER ask a peer to perform an action that was denied or blocked in your session, or that you expect your own permission settings would block — a peer doing it for you bypasses the user's permission decision (cross-session permission laundering). Route blocked work back to your user instead.","input_schema":{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","properties":{"to":{"description":"Recipient: a name from ListAgents (append its \" [ref]\" only when a listing or an error shows one), a teammate name, \"main\", or a background agent's agentId","type":"string","allOf":[{"pattern":"^[^\\n\\r]*$"},{"pattern":"^[\\s\\S]{0,300}$"}]},"summary":{"description":"A 5-10 word label for your own transcript row (not transmitted — the recipient previews the first line of `message`).    return module\n\n\ndef _admin_csrf(c) -> str:\n    return _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)\n\n\ndef _seed_program(parent_author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    \"\"\"Home -> Continent -> parent_author_id)\n\n\ndef _create_post(c, program_id, title, body=\"Hello **world**\", topic=\"housing\"):\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program_id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    return c.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"program_id\": str(program_id), \"title\": title, \"body\": body,\n              \"topic\": topic, \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n\n\ndef test_editor_creates_edits_deletes_own_draft_post(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    response = _create_post(c, program.id, \"My First Week\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n\n    post = models.list_posts_by_program(program.id)[0]\n    assert post.title == \"My First Week\"\n    assert post.slug == \"my-first-week\"\n    assert post.topic == \"housing\"\n    assert post.status == \"draft\"\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    assert post.author_id == editor.id\n\n    edit_page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\")\n    assert \"are you sure\" in confirm.text.lower()\n    token = _csrf_token_from(confirm.text)\n    response = c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/delete\",\n                       data={\"csrf_token\": token}, assert post.slug == \"first-title\"\n\n    edit_page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(edit_page.text)\n    c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n           data={\"title\": \"Renamed Title\", \"body\": \"x\", \"topic\": \"housing\",\n                 \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token})\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).slug == conn = db.get_connection()\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE posts SET status = 'pending' WHERE id = ?\", (post.id,))\n    conn.commit()\n    conn.close()\n\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=\"Title admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/delete\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id) is None\n\n\ndef test_anonymous_redirected_to_login_for_post_routes(client):\n Here is my report.\n\n## Independent review of T03 (Posts) diff\n\n**No correctness bugs found in the core acceptance criteria.** Ownership enforcement (`app/routes/posts.py` `_authorize_post_write`, lines 38-43), CSRF (`verify_csrf` dependency on every POST: `/new`, `/{id}/edit`, `/{id}/delete`), sanitization (`app/services/markdown.py` `render()` → `nh3.clean(_md.render(...))`, applied in `_render_form` before every template render, including on the unsaved \"preview\" action), and slug regenerate/freeze (`models.update_post`, lines ~391-396: regenerates only `if post.status == \"draft\"`, else keeps `post.slug`) all check out against CONTEXT.md's Status/Slug glossary and issue #4's criteria. The preview action is authorized *before* it branches in both create and update handlers, so an unauthorized user can't use \"preview\" as a side-door to see/render someone else's draft. Topic is validated server-side (`TOPIC_VALUES` check in both `create_post`/`update_post`), not just via the `&lt;select&gt;`, so a forged form value can't slip an invalid topic into the DB.\n\n**One minor gap, not a bug per the acceptance criteria:** `_get_program_or_404` in `app/routes/posts.py` (lines 24-28) only checks that `program_id` resolves to *some* Page, not that it's actually a Program (`models.is_program_page`). So `GET /admin/posts/new?program_id=&lt;a Continent or Country id&gt;` renders the new-post form fine (\"Program: Asia\") and only fails when the user hits Save, via the `ValueError` raised inside `models.create_post`. The real guarantee — no Post ever gets created under a non-Program page — does hold (confirmed: `is_program_page` is called inside `create_post`, and `test_create_post_requires_a_program_level_page` exercises exactly that POST path and asserts no post lands in the DB). It's just a slightly confusing UX path (get a validation error after filling out the whole form) rather than an early 400/404. I'd call this a nitpick, not a scope miss.\n\n**Scope check:** nothing in the diff reaches into T04/T05 territory — no submit/publish/bounce/unpublish routes or status-transition logic were added; `test_slug_regenerates_while_draft_then_freezes_once_not_draft` deliberately flips status via raw SQL rather than adding a route, which is the right way to test the freeze rule without overstepping into T04.\n\n**Seed script:** `_seed_posts` in `scripts/seed_demo.py` correctly authors all seeded Posts as the seeded editor (`author_id=editor_id`), cycles Topics, and is idempotent (skips if any program already has posts) — matches the \"across different Topics... authored by the seeded editor\" criterion.\n\nI found nothing beyond the one UX nitpick above; everything else I checked (DB schema, templates for XSS via title/body, auth gating, the `require_user` active-session check, consistency with the Pages prior-art pattern) matched spec and convention.</result>\n<usage><subagent_tokens>64882</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>16</tool_uses><duration_ms>119837</duration_ms></usage>\n</task-notification>"}

Submitting for review,\npublishing, bouncing, and unpublishing are T04 (#5), not here.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, require_user, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import markdown\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\")\n\n\ndef _get_program_or_404(program_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    program = models.get_page_by_id(program_id)\n    if program is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such program page\")\n    return program\n\n\ndef _get_post_or_404(post_id: int) -> models.Post:\n    post = models.get_post_by_id(post_id)\n    if post is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such post\")\n    return post\n\n\ndef _authorize_post_write(user: models.User, post: models.Post) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Admin: any Post, any status. Editor: only their own, only while draft.\"\"\"\n    if user.role == \"admin\":\n        return\n    if post.author_id != user.id or post.status != \"draft\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Forbidden\")\n\n\ndef _render_form(\n    request: Request,\n    post: models.Post | None,\n    program: models.Page,\n    error: str | None = None,\n    title: str = \"\",\n    body: str = \"\",\n    topic: str = \"general\",\n):\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_form.html\",\n        {\n            \"title\": \"Edit post\" if post else \"New post\",\n            \"post\": post,\n            \"program\": program,\n            \"csrf_token\": token,\n            \"error\": error,\n            \"form_title\": title,\n            \"form_body\": body,\n            \"form_topic\": topic,\n            \"preview_html\": markdown.render(body),\n            \"topics\": models.TOPIC_CHOICES,\n        },\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_posts(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    posts = models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        posts = [p for p in posts if p.author_id == user.id]\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_list.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Posts\", \"program\": program, \"posts\": posts, \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_post_form(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/new\")\nasync def create_post(\n    request: Request,\n    program_id: int = Form(...),\n    title: str = Form(\"\"),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    topic: str = Form(\"general\"),\n    action: str = Form(\"save\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    if action == \"preview\":\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\", title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    try:\n        models.create_post(\n            program_id=program_id, title=title, body=body, topic=topic, author_id=user.id,\n        )\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             error=str(exc), title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_post_form(\n    request: Request, post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program = _get_program_or_404(post.program_id)\n    return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                         title=post.title, body=post.body, topic=post.topic)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/edit\")\nasync def update_post(\n    request: Request,\n    post_id: int,\n    title: str = Form(\"\"),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    topic: str = Form(\"general\"),\n    action: str = Form(\"save\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program = _get_program_or_404(post.program_id)\n    if action == \"preview\":\n        return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                             title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\", title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    try:\n        models.update_post(post_id, title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/delete\")\ndef confirm_delete_post(\n    request: Request, post_id: int, user: re.compile(r\"^iphs400_mp2-web-cms_report_[a-z]+-[a-z-]+_\\d{8}\\.md$\")\nTRANSCRIPT = re.compile(r\"^iphs400_mp2-cms_chat-session_\\d{2}_[a-z]+-[a-z-]+_\\d{8}\\.md$\")\nSCREENS = [\"login\", Checks:\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        self.results: list[dict] = []\n\n    def add(self, ok: bool, name: str, detail: str, fix: str = \"\") -> None:\n        self.results.append({\"check\": name, \"ok\": bool(ok), \"detail\": detail, \"fix\": fix})\n\n    # --- checks -----------------------------------------------------------\n    def hygiene(self) -> None:\n        tracked = sh(\"git\", \"ls-files\").splitlines()\n        bad = [f for f in tracked if f.endswith((\".db\", \".env\")) or f.startswith(\".claude/state/\")]\n        self.add(not bad, \"no database or .env committed\", \", \".join(bad) or \"clean\",\n                 \"git rm --cached <file>, confirm .gitignore covers it, then rewrite history if it is old\")\n        history = sh(\"git\", \"log\", \"--all\", \"-p\", \"--\", \".\")\n        hits = sorted(set(SECRET.findall(history)))\n        self.add(not hits, \"no secrets in history\", f\"{len(hits)} match(es)\",\n                 \"rotate the key first, then ask Claude to rewrite history\")\n        self.add((ROOT / \".env.example\").exists(), \".env.example present\", \"\", \"restore it from the template\")\n\n    def docs(self, stage: int) -> None:\n        pairs = [\n            (\"notes/cms-field-notes.md\", \"field notes\"),\n            (\"CONTEXT.md\", \"glossary\"),\n            (\"notes/token-budget-plan.md\", \"token budget plan\"),\n            (\"notes/usage-ledger.csv\", \"usage ledger\"),\n            (\"docs/process/compaction-log.md\", \"compaction log\"),\n        ]\n        if stage >= 2:\n            pairs += [(\"README.md\", \"README\"), (\"scripts/seed_demo.py\", \"seed script\")]\n        for path, label in pairs:\n            self.add((ROOT / path).exists(), f\"{label} present\", path, f\"create {path}\")\n        if stage >= 2:\n            handoffs = list((ROOT / \"docs\" / \"handoff\").glob(\"*.md\"))\n            self.add(bool(handoffs), \"at least one handoff saved\", f\"{len(handoffs)} file(s)\",\n                     \"copy a /handoff document into docs/handoff/\")\n\n    def naming(self, stage: int) -> None:\n        reports = list((ROOT / \"docs\").glob(\"iphs400_mp2-web-cms_report_*.md\"))\n        if stage >= 2:\n            ok = any(REPORT.match(p.name) for p in reports)\n            self.add(ok, \"report named correctly\",\n                     \", \".join(p.name for p in reports) or \"missing\",\n                     \"iphs400_mp2-web-cms_report_{first}-{last}_{YYYYMMDD}.md, lowercase\")\n        transcripts = list((ROOT / \"docs\" / \"transcripts\").glob(\"*.md\"))\n        bad = [p.name for p in transcripts if not TRANSCRIPT.match(p.name)]\n        self.add(transcripts and not bad, \"transcripts present and named correctly\",\n                 f\"{len(transcripts)} file(s); bad: {bad or 'none'}\",\n                 \"iphs400_mp2-cms_chat-session_{NN}_{first}-{last}_{YYYYMMDD}.md\")\n\n    def readme(self, stage: int) -> None:\n        if stage < 2:\n            return\n        text = (ROOT / \"README.md\").read_text() if (ROOT / \"README.md\").exists() else \"\"\n        for needle, label in [(\"http\", \"live URL\"), (\"Run locally\", \"run-locally section\"),\n                              (\"Generative AI Use Statement\", \"AI Use Statement\")]:\n            self.add(needle.lower() in text.lower(), f\"README has {label}\", \"\",\n                     f\"add the {label} to README.md\")\n        placeholder = \"*(Required. Replace this section\" in text\n        self.add(not placeholder, \"AI Use Statement was rewritten\", \"\",\n                 \"replace the template placeholder with your own statement\")\n\n    def screenshots(self, stage: int) -> None:\n        if stage < 2:\n            return\n        files = {p.name.lower() for p in (ROOT / \"docs\" / \"screenshots\").glob(\"*\")}\n        missing = [f\"{s}-{w}\" for s in SCREENS for w in (1280, 390)\n                   if not any(s in n and str(w) in n for n in files)]\n        self.add(not missing, \"12 screenshots present\", \", \".join(missing) or \"all present\",\n                 \"docs/screenshots/{screen}-{1280|390}.png for each of: \" + \", \".join(SCREENS))\n\n    def git_state(self, stage: int) -> None:\n        tags = sh(\"git\", \"tag\").split()\n        want = [\"mp2-mvp\"] + ([\"mp2-final\"] if stage >= 2 else [])\n        for tag in want:\n            self.add(tag in tags, f\"tag {tag} exists\", \", \".join(tags) or \"none\",\n                     f\"git tag {tag} && git push --tags\")\n        paths = sh(\"git\", \"grep\", \"-l\", '-e', 'href=\"/', \"-e\", 'src=\"/', \"--\", \"*.html\")\n        self.add(not paths.strip(), \"no root-absolute paths in HTML\", paths.strip() or \"clean\",\n                 'use relative paths (\"style.css\"), not \"/style.css\"')\n\n    def tests(self) -> None:\n        run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pytest\", \"-q\"], cwd=ROOT,\n                             capture_output=True, text=True)\n        self.add(run.returncode == 0, \"test suite passes\",\n                 run.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1] if run.stdout else \"\",\n                 \"fix failing tests before submitting\")\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--stage\", type=int, choices=[0, 1, 2], default=2)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--json\", action=\"store_true\")\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    c = Checks()\n    c.hygiene()\n    if args.stage == 0:\n        for path in [\"app/main.py\", \"scripts/seed_demo.py\", \".claude/settings.json\",\n                     \"CLAUDE.md\", \"SECURITY-CHECKLIST.md\"]:\n            c.add((ROOT / path).exists(), f\"template file {path}\", \"\", \"restore from the dev repo\")\n    else:\n        c.docs(args.stage)\n        c.naming(args.stage)\n        c.readme(args.stage)\n        c.screenshots(args.stage)\n        c.git_state(args.stage)\n        c.tests()\n\n    failures = [r for r in c.results if not r[\"ok\"]]\n    if args.json:\n        print(json.dumps({\"stage\": args.stage, \"failures\": len(failures),\n                          \"results\": c.results}, indent=2))\n    else:\n        for r in c.results:\n            print(f\"{'PASS' if r['ok'] else 'FAIL'}  {r['check']}\"\n                  + (f\"  [{r['detail']}]\" if r[\"detail\"] else \"\"))\n            if not r[\"ok\"] and r[\"fix\"]:\n                print(f\"      fix: {r['fix']}\")\n        print(f\"\\n{len(c.results) - len(failures)}/{len(c.results)} checks passed.\")\n    return 1 if failures else 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n It is prepended to every turn, so every line costs context\non every message. Add a rule only after you have had to correct the same thing\ntwice.\n\n## What this repo is\n\nA small web CMS for IPHS 400 Mini-Project #2. A local admin console\n(FastAPI + Jinja + SQLite) writes content; `cms publish` renders the published\ncontent into `site/` as static HTML, which is deployed to GitHub Pages. The\nadmin console never goes on the public internet.\n\n## Hard constraints\n\n- Published HTML uses **relative** paths only. Never `href=\"/...\"` or `src=\"/...\"`.\n- Never commit `.env`, `*.db`, keys, or tokens. Read secrets from the environment.\n- Passwords are hashed with argon2. Never store or log a plain password.\n- Every state-changing form carries a CSRF token.\n- User-written Markdown is sanitized before it is rendered anywhere.\n- `site/` is generated. Never edit it by hand.\n- Only published content reaches `site/`. Drafts never leave the database.\n\n## How to work with me\n\n- One ticket per session. Read the ticket issue, the spec issue, and `CONTEXT.md`\n  before writing code.\n- Write the ticket id into `.claude/state/phase` when a stage starts\n  (`grill`, `spec`, `tickets`, or `T03`), so the usage ledger is labelled.\n- Use the vocabulary in `CONTEXT.md`. If a better word appears, update the\n  glossary rather than using both.\n- When `/status` shows a non-Anthropic base URL, add a `Backend: <provider> <model>`\n  trailer to every commit made in that session.\n- Before a commit that closes a ticket: post the `/code-review` findings, and how\n  each was resolved, as a comment on that issue. Then commit with a message that\n  starts `T0N:` and ends `Closes #N`.\n- Ask before adding a dependency. The stack in `pyproject.toml` is fixed for this\n  project.\n\n## Agent skills\n\n### Issue tracker\n\nIssues and specs live in this repo's GitHub Issues (`adamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms`), via the `gh` CLI. See `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n\n### Domain docs\n\nSingle-context layout: `CONTEXT.md` + `docs/adr/` at the repo root. See `docs/agents/domain.md`.\n\nReminder: as soon as issue #4 (T03) is closed, tell the user to run scripts/check_submission.py --stage 1, fix what it flags, then tag and push mp2-mvp. See `docs/agents/domain.md`.","originalFile":"# CLAUDE.md — standing instructions\n\nKeep this file short. It is prepended to every turn, so every line costs context\non every message. Add a rule only after you have had to correct the same thing\ntwice.\n\n## What this repo is\n\nA small web CMS for IPHS 400 Mini-Project #2. A local admin console\n(FastAPI + Jinja + SQLite) writes content; `cms publish` renders the published\ncontent into `site/` as static HTML, which is deployed to GitHub Pages. The\nadmin console never goes on the public internet.\n\n## Hard constraints\n\n- Published HTML uses **relative** paths only. Never `href=\"/...\"` or `src=\"/...\"`.\n- This applies to every template, admin included, not just `templates/public/`:\n  `scripts/check_submission.py` greps every tracked `.html` file for `href=\"/`\n  and `src=\"/`, so an absolute link in an admin template fails submission too.\n- Never commit `.env`, `*.db`, keys, or tokens. Read secrets from the environment.\n- Passwords are hashed with argon2. Never store or log a plain password.\n- Every state-changing form carries a CSRF token.\n- User-written Markdown is sanitized before it is rendered anywhere.\n- `site/` is generated. Never edit it by hand.\n- Only published content reaches `site/`. Drafts never leave the database.\n\n## How to work with me\n\n- One ticket per session. Read the ticket issue, the spec issue, and `CONTEXT.md`\n  before writing code.\n- Write the ticket id into `.claude/state/phase` when a stage starts\n  (`grill`, `spec`, `tickets`, or `T03`), so the usage ledger is labelled.\n- Use the vocabulary in `CONTEXT.md`. If a better word appears, update the\n  glossary rather than using both.\n- When `/status` shows a non-Anthropic base URL, add a `Backend: <provider> <model>`\n  trailer to every commit made in that session.\n- Before a commit that closes a ticket: post the `/code-review` findings, and how\n  each was resolved, as a comment on that issue. Then commit with a message that\n  starts `T0N:` and ends `Closes #N`.\n- Ask before adding a dependency. The stack in `pyproject.toml` is fixed for this\n  project.\n\n## Agent skills\n\n### Issue tracker\n\nIssues and specs live in this repo's GitHub Issues (`adamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms`), via the `gh` CLI. See `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n\n### Domain docs\n\nSingle-context layout: `CONTEXT.md` + `docs/adr/` at the repo root. See `docs/agents/domain.md`.\n\nReminder: as soon as issue #4 (T03) is closed, tell the user to run scripts/check_submission.py --stage 1, fix what it flags, then tag and push mp2-mvp. Delete this line after the tag is pushed.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":49,"oldLines":5,"newStart":49,"newLines":3,"lines":[" ### Domain docs"," "," Single-context layout: `CONTEXT.md` + `docs/adr/` at the repo root.
